comment: The panel prints SVF; the model slug is SVF-1. The plugin README says the filters use an IIR or FIR antialiasing filter, but fir.cpp is never referenced by any filter core in this version — only IIRLowpass is instantiated, so the decimation is always IIR. Cutoff is held as a normalised integration rate rather than a frequency (SVF.cpp:90 maps the knob to 0.001 to 2.251, svfilter.cpp:171 scales it by 44100 over the working rate), so no cutoff in hertz can be quoted from the source. The resonance sign flip is svfilter.cpp:223, fb = 1 - 3.5 * Resonance.
